text: The shortest distance between the line x $-$ y = 1 and the curve $x^{2} = 2y$ is :
sourceReference: NTA JEE Main JEE Main 2021 (Online) 25th February Evening Shift via ExamSIDE (questions.examside.com)

solution.body:
Shortest distance must be along common normal


[IMG]


Let a point on curve has x coordinate = h

Then y coordinate :

$h^{2} = 2y$

$\Rightarrow$ y = $\frac{h^{2}}{2}$

So point is = (h, $\frac{h^{2}}{2}$)

$m_{1} ($slope of line x $-$ y = 1) = 1 

$\Rightarrow$ slope of perpendicular line = $-$1

Slope of the perpendicular line on the curve $x^{2} = 2y$,

$m_{2}=\frac{2x}{2}=x\Rightarrow m_{2}=h$

$\therefore$ Slope of normal = $-\frac{1}{h}$

$-\frac{1}{h}$ = $-$1 $\Rightarrow$ h = 1

So point is $\left (1,\frac{1}{2}\right )$

$D=\left |\frac{1-\frac{1}{2}-1}{\sqrt{1+1}}\right |=\frac{1}{2\sqrt{2}}$

text: A function f(x) is given by $f(x)=\frac{5^{x}}{5^{x}+5}$, then the sum of the series $f\left (\frac{1}{20}\right )+f\left (\frac{2}{20}\right )+f\left (\frac{3}{20}\right )+.......+f\left (\frac{39}{20}\right )$ is equal to :
sourceReference: NTA JEE Main JEE Main 2021 (Online) 25th February Evening Shift via ExamSIDE (questions.examside.com)

solution.body:
$f(x)=\frac{5^{x}}{5^{x}+5}$ ..... (i)

$f(2-x)=\frac{5^{2-x}}{5^{2-x}+5}$

$f(2-x)=\frac{5}{5^{x}+5}$ .... (ii)

Adding equation (i) and (ii) 

$f(x)+f(2-x)=1$

$f\left (\frac{1}{20}\right )+f\left (\frac{39}{20}\right )=1$

$f\left (\frac{2}{20}\right )+f\left (\frac{38}{20}\right )=1$

$\begin{array}{ll}  & : \\  & : \end{array}$

$f\left (\frac{19}{20}\right )+f\left (\frac{21}{20}\right )=1$

and $f\left (\frac{20}{20}\right )=f(1)=\frac{1}{2}$

$\therefore$ Sum = $19+\frac{1}{2}=\frac{39}{2}$

text: The integral $\int \frac{e^{3\log e2x}+5e^{2\log e2x}}{e^{4\log ex}+5e^{3\log ex}-7e^{2\log ex}}dx$, x > 0, is equal to : (where c is a constant of integration)
sourceReference: NTA JEE Main JEE Main 2021 (Online) 25th February Evening Shift via ExamSIDE (questions.examside.com)

solution.body:
$\int \frac{e^{3\log e2x}+5e^{2\log e2x}}{e^{4\log ex}+5e^{3\log ex}-7e^{2\log ex}}dx$

$=\int \frac{8x^{3}+5(4x^{2})}{x^{4}+5x^{3}-7x^{2}}$

$=\int \frac{8x^{3}+20x^{2}}{x^{4}+5x^{3}-7x^{2}}$

$=\int \frac{8x+20}{x^{2}+5x-7}$

$=\int \frac{4(2x+5)}{x^{2}+5x-7}$ 

Let $\left \{\begin{array}{l} x^{2}+5x-7=t \\ (2x+5)dx=dt \end{array}\right \}$

$=\int \frac{4dt}{t}$

$=4\ln |t|+C$

$=4\ln \left |(x^{2}+5x-7)\right |+C$

Here C is integral constant.
sourceReferences: ExamSIDE explanation for JEE Main 2021 (Online) 25th February Evening Shift

+ n (7 does not appear on thousands place)

text: If 0 < x, y < $π$ and cosx + cosy $-$ cos(x + y) = $\frac{3}{2}$, then sinx + cosy is equal to :
sourceReference: NTA JEE Main JEE Main 2021 (Online) 25th February Evening Shift via ExamSIDE (questions.examside.com)

solution.body:
Let $u=\cos \dfrac{x+y}{2}$ and $v=\cos \dfrac{x-y}{2}$. Then $\cos x+\cos y=2uv$ and $\cos (x+y)=2u^{2}-1$, so the condition becomes

$2uv-(2u^{2}-1)=\dfrac{3}{2}\Rightarrow 4u^{2}-4uv+1=0\Rightarrow (2u-v)^{2}+(1-v^{2})=0$

Both terms are non-negative since $v^{2}\leq 1$, so $v^{2}=1$ and $2u=v$.

As $0<x,y<π$, $\left |\dfrac{x-y}{2}\right |<\dfrac{π}{2}$, so $v>0$; hence $v=1$, which gives $x=y$, and then $u=\cos x=\dfrac{1}{2}$, so $x=y=\dfrac{π}{3}$.

Check: $\cos \dfrac{π}{3}+\cos \dfrac{π}{3}-\cos \dfrac{2π}{3}=\dfrac{1}{2}+\dfrac{1}{2}+\dfrac{1}{2}=\dfrac{3}{2}$.

$\sin x+\cos y=\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}+\dfrac{1}{2}=\dfrac{1+\sqrt{3}}{2}$

Hence, the correct option is (A).
sourceReferences: ExamSIDE explanation for JEE Main 2021 (Online) 25th February Evening Shift

$\cos ec\left (2\cot ^{-1}(5)+\cos ^{-1}\left (\frac{4}{5}\right )\right )$

$=\cos ec(θ+𝜙)$

$=\frac{1}{\sin θ\cos 𝜙+\cos θ\sin 𝜙}$

$=\frac{1}{\frac{5}{13}.\frac{4}{5}+\frac{12}{13}.\frac{3}{5}}=\frac{65}{56}$

text: If $α$, $β$ $\in$ R are such that 1 $-$ 2i (here $i^{2} =$ $-$1) is a root of $z^{2} +$ $α$z + $β$ = 0, then ($α$ $-$ $β$) is equal to :

text: In a group of 400 people, 160 are smokers and non-vegetarian; 100 are smokers and vegetarian and the remaining 140 are non-smokers and vegetarian. Their chances of getting a particular chest disorder are 35%, 20% and 10% respectively. A person is chosen from the group at random and is found to be suffering from the chest disorder. The probability that the selected person is a smoker and non-vegetarian is :
sourceReference: NTA JEE Main JEE Main 2021 (Online) 25th February Evening Shift via ExamSIDE (questions.examside.com)

solution.body:
Consider following events

A : Person chosen is a smoker and non vegetarian.

B : Person chosen in a smoker and vegetarian.

C : Person chosen is a non-smoker and vegetarian.

E : Person chosen has a chest disorder

Given 

$P(A)=\frac{160}{400}$

$P(B)=\frac{100}{400}$

$P(C)=\frac{140}{400}$

$P\left (\frac{E}{A}\right )=\frac{35}{100}$

$P\left (\frac{E}{B}\right )=\frac{20}{100}$

$P\left (\frac{E}{C}\right )=\frac{10}{100}$

To find

$P\left (\frac{A}{E}\right )=\frac{P(A)P\left (\frac{E}{A}\right )}{P(A).P\left (\frac{E}{A}\right )+P(B).P\left (\frac{E}{B}\right )+P(C).P\left (\frac{E}{C}\right )}$

$=\frac{\frac{160}{400}\times \frac{35}{100}}{\frac{160}{400}\times \frac{35}{100}\times \frac{100}{400}\times \frac{20}{200}+\frac{140}{400}\times \frac{10}{100}}$

$=\frac{28}{45}$

text: The total number of two digit numbers 'n', such that $3^{n} + 7^{n}$ is a multiple of 10, is $__________$.
sourceReference: NTA JEE Main JEE Main 2021 (Online) 25th February Evening Shift via ExamSIDE (questions.examside.com)

solution.body:
$\because$ $7^{n}=(10-3)^{n}=10k+(-3)^{n}$

$7^{n}+3^{n}=10k+(-3)^{n}+3^{n}$


[IMG]


$\therefore$ $3^{n} = 3^{2t} = (10$ $-$ $1)^{t}$

= 10p + ($-1)^{t}$

= 10p $\pm$ 1

$\therefore$ if n = even then $7^{n} + 3^{n}$ will not be multiply of 10

So if n is odd then only $7^{n} + 3^{n}$ will be multiply of 10

$\therefore$ n = 11, 13, 15, ..........., 99

$\therefore$ Ans : 45

text:
A line 'l' passing through origin is perpendicular to the lines

$l_{1}:\vec{r}=(3+t)\hat{i}+(-1+2t)\hat{j}+(4+2t)\widehat{k}$

$l_{2}:\vec{r}=(3+2s)\hat{i}+(3+2s)\hat{j}+(2+s)\widehat{k}$

If the co-ordinates of the point in the first octant on $'l_{2}$‘ at a distance of $\sqrt{17}$ from the point of intersection of 'l' and $'l_{1}'$ are (a, b, c) then 18(a + b + c) is equal to $___________$.
sourceReference: NTA JEE Main JEE Main 2021 (Online) 25th February Evening Shift via ExamSIDE (questions.examside.com)

solution.body:
$l_{1}:\vec{r}=(3+t)\hat{i}+(-1+2t)\hat{j}+(4+2t)\widehat{k}$

$l_{1}:\frac{x-3}{1}=\frac{y+1}{2}=\frac{z-4}{2}\Rightarrow$ D.R. of $l_{1}=1,2,2$

$l_{2}:\vec{r}=(3+2s)\hat{i}+(3+2s)\hat{j}+(2+s)\widehat{k}$

$l_{2}:\frac{x-3}{2}=\frac{y-3}{2}=\frac{z-2}{1}\Rightarrow$ D.R. of $l_{2}=2,2,1$

D.R. of l is $⊥$ to $l_{1}$ & $l_{2}$

$\therefore$ D.R. of $l\; ||\quad (l_{1}\times l_{2})\Rightarrow (-2,3,-2)$

$\therefore$ Equation of $l:\frac{x}{2}=\frac{y}{-3}=\frac{z}{2}$

Solving l & $l_{1}$

$(2λ,-3λ,2λ)=(μ+3,2μ-1,2μ+4)$

$\Rightarrow 2λ=μ+3$

$-3λ=2μ-1$

$2λ=2μ+4$

$\Rightarrow μ+3=2μ+4$

$μ=-1$

$λ=1$

$P(2,-3,2)$ {intersection point}

Let, $Q(2v+3,2v+3,v+2)$ be point on $l_{2}$

Now, $PQ=\sqrt{(2v+3-2)^{2}+(2v+3+3)^{2}+(v+2-2)^{2}}=\sqrt{17}$

$\Rightarrow (2v+1)^{2}+(2v+6)^{2}+(v)^{2}=17$

$\Rightarrow 9v^{2}+28v+36+1-17=0$

$\Rightarrow 9v^{2}+28v+20=0$

$\Rightarrow 9v^{2}+18v+10v+20=0$

$\Rightarrow (9v+10)(v+2)=0$

$\Rightarrow v=-2$ (rejected), $-\frac{10}{9}$ (accepted)

$Q\left (3-\frac{20}{9},3-\frac{20}{9},2-\frac{10}{9}\right )$

$\left (\frac{7}{9},\frac{7}{9},\frac{8}{9}\right )$

$\therefore$ $18(a+b+c)$

$=18\left (\frac{7}{9}+\frac{7}{9}+\frac{8}{9}\right )$

$=44$

text: Let $\vec{a}=\hat{i}+α\hat{j}+3\widehat{k}$ and $\vec{b}=3\hat{i}-α\hat{j}+\widehat{k}$. If the area of the parallelogram whose adjacent sides are represented by the vectors $\vec{a}$ and $\vec{b}$ is $8\sqrt{3}$ square units, then $\vec{a}$ . $\vec{b}$ is equal to $__________$.
sourceReference: NTA JEE Main JEE Main 2021 (Online) 25th February Evening Shift via ExamSIDE (questions.examside.com)

solution.body:
$\vec{a}=\hat{i}+α\hat{j}+3\widehat{k}$

$\vec{b}=3\hat{i}-α\hat{j}+\widehat{k}$

Area of parallelogram = $\left |\vec{a}\times \vec{b}\right |$

$=\left |(\hat{i}+α\hat{j}+3\widehat{k})\times (3\hat{i}-α\hat{j}+\widehat{k})\right |$

$8\sqrt{3}=\left |(4α)\hat{i}+8\hat{j}-(4α)\widehat{k}\right |$

$(64)(3)=16α^{2}+64+16α^{2}$

$(64)(3)=32α^{2}+64$

$6=α^{2}+2$

$α^{2}=4$

$\therefore$ $\vec{a}=\hat{i}+α\hat{j}+3\widehat{k}$

$\vec{b}=3\hat{i}-α\hat{j}+\widehat{k}$

$\vec{a}\quad .\vec{b}=3-α^{2}+3$

$=6-α^{2}$

$=6-4$

$=2$

solution.body:
$\lim _{x\to 0}\frac{ax-\left (e^{4x}-1\right )}{ax(e^{4x}-1)}$

Applying L' Hospital Rule

$\lim _{x\to 0}\frac{a-4e^{4x}}{a(e^{4x}-1)+ax(4e^{4x})}$

This is $\frac{a-4}{0}$.

 limit exist only when $a-4=0$ $\Rightarrow$ a = 4

Applying L' Hospital Rule

$\lim _{x\to 0}\frac{-16e^{4x}}{a(4e^{4x})+a(4e^{4x})+ax(16e^{4x})}$

= $\frac{-16}{4a+4a}=\frac{-16}{32}=-\frac{1}{2}=b$

$a-2b=4-2\left (\frac{-1}{2}\right )=4+1=5$
sourceReferences: ExamSIDE explanation for JEE Main 2021 (Online) 25th February Evening Shift

text: If the curve, y = y(x) represented by the solution of the differential equation $(2xy^{2}$ $-$ y)dx + xdy = 0, passes through the intersection of the lines, 2x $-$ 3y = 1 and 3x + 2y = 8, then |y(1)| is equal to $_________$.
sourceReference: NTA JEE Main JEE Main 2021 (Online) 25th February Evening Shift via ExamSIDE (questions.examside.com)

solution.body:
Given, 

$(2xy^{2}-y)dx+xdy=0$

$\Rightarrow \frac{dy}{dx}+2y^{2}-\frac{y}{x}=0$

$\Rightarrow -\frac{1}{y^{2}}\frac{dy}{dx}+\frac{1}{y}\left (\frac{1}{x}\right )=2$

$\frac{1}{y}=z$

$-\frac{1}{y^{2}}\frac{dy}{dx}=\frac{dz}{dx}$

$\Rightarrow \frac{dz}{dx}+z\left (\frac{1}{x}\right )=2$

I. F. $=e^{\int \frac{1}{x}dx}=x$

$\therefore$ $z(x)=\int 2(x)dx=x^{2}+c$

$\Rightarrow \frac{x}{y}=x^{2}+c$

As it passes through P(2, 1)

[Point of intersection of $2x-3y=1$ and $3x+2y=8$]

$\therefore$ $\frac{2}{1}=4+c$

$\Rightarrow c=-2$

$\Rightarrow \frac{x}{y}=x^{2}-2$

Put x = 1

$\frac{1}{y}=1-2=-1$

$\Rightarrow y(1)=-1$

$\Rightarrow |y(1)|=1$
sourceReferences: ExamSIDE explanation for JEE Main 2021 (Online) 25th February Evening Shift
